title: Height and Setback Regulations
previewText: Buildings or other structures within the Special District shall comply with the height and setback regulations of Section 35-63 (Height and Setback Requirements in Commercial Districts with R6 Through 12 Equivalency) except that within the C4-5X District west of 70th Road, the minimum base height of the street wall shall be 40 feet.
